investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Harborshore Education (online learning); Platform: on-premises data center DC-South, server range 172.20.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster harbor-prod (kubeadm); Billing: a daily charge job 'premium-collection' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'tick-scheduler', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (America/New_York); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
